Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
- A vamp with Aching Beauty bleeds, is blocked ; prey burns from AB ; can
the bleeder still play superior Form of Mist ? If he's blocked again, will
the prey burn again from AB ?

--
Orpheus
-----------------------
My story doesn't happen in the sound of the notes
but in the silence between them.
That is where the magic happens.

Echo
